description: This file defines the CountryDao class responsible for data access operations related to countries and provinces within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve lists, and specific entries based on country codes, country names, province codes, and province names.

classes.name: CountryDao
classes.description: Data access object class for retrieving country and province data from the database.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all countries ordered by name.

methods.name: getProvinceList
methods.description: Fetches a list of provinces, optionally filtered by country code.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Retrieves a country entity based on the country name.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Fetches a country entity by its country code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Retrieves a province entity by its province code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceName
methods.description: Retrieves a province entity by its name.
